patronOf.en-US: The cup of the Blood of Christ
patronOf.pt-BR: O cálice do Sangue de Cristo

prayerExcerpt.en-US: Our blessing-cup is a communion with the blood of Christ.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: O cálice por nós abençoado, é a nossa comunhão com o sangue do Senhor.

meta.basis: The chalice and paten are 'held in special honor' among the sacred vessels (GIRM 327). Sacred vessels are 'made from precious metal' and, if of a metal less precious than gold, 'gilded on the inside' (GIRM 328); a chalice has 'a bowl of material that does not absorb liquids' (GIRM 330); glass, earthenware and clay are reprobated (Redemptionis Sacramentum 117). The form is left to the artist and regional custom (GIRM 332): the card takes a traditional silver-gilt chalice with knop and foot. The excerpt is the refrain of the Psalm at the Evening Mass of the Lord's Supper (1 Cor 10:16).
